author: Daniel Greene
description:
Well, I am reading the bible. 
I'm not a Christian. I've never read the Bible. But I've reviewed hundreds of books and I wanted to come to the most influential text in Western history the same way I come to everything else — as a reader, with fresh eyes.

🧙‍♂️ Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/DanielBGreene
title: I Listened To The Bible Driving Across America
